about: ISTAT (Italian National Institute of Statistics), Migration (transfer of residence): 'Immigrants - country of origin' (28_185_DF_DCIS_MIGRAZIONI_3, registrations from abroad, country of previous residence Poland) and 'Emigrants - countries of next residence' (28_185_DF_DCIS_MIGRAZIONI_6, cancellations to abroad, Poland), all citizenships, both sexes, all ages, 2002-2024, via the SDMX API https://esploradati.istat.it/SDMXWS/rest/data/ (downloaded 2026-11-10). 'immigration' = registrations from Poland, 'emigration' = cancellations for Poland. From 2011 the values equal Eurostat migr_imm5prv and migr_emi3nxt; for 2008-10 ISTAT's current values are lower than Eurostat's (from Poland 11,601, 9,071, 7,230 vs 12,561, 9,334, 7,414; to Poland 1,489, 1,472, 1,338 vs 1,929, 2,253, 1,588).
